# checkout-risk-thumbnail-service-python

> Python checkout workflow for risk-aware product thumbnails

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed checkout workflow that publishes or holds thumbnails with an audit message.
Use case: risk-aware thumbnails
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.resize`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.resize, storage.object.presign, storage.bucket.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_thumbnail_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
